system.description:
The circle of Rillifane's Grove under the Hierophant Myrah Arianel, which keeps the Forest of Myllnoris and has deep ties to its High Elven Council.

  • Reshapes: Resist Elements (against fey magic).
  • Fey Warding: Advantage on saves against charm, enchantment and fey magic.
    • 9th level: allies within 10ft of you share it.
  • Warden's Kin: Advantage on checks to speak with or identify creatures of the deep forest, and Myllnoris's woodland wardens know you as an ally on sight.
